title: Update to Tautulli Remote v3.6.1+ & Tautulli v2.18.0+ to avoid notification issues
body: Tomorrow, October 1st, our current notification relay service OneSignal is changing their plans and we will no longer be able to use them. We have implemented our own solution that is live in Tautulli Remove v3.6.1+ and also requires Tautulli v2.18.0+. Please update today to avoid notification issues.

title: Introducing App Styles
body: It's been exactly a year now since the last Tautulli Remote update. Today V3.5.0 starts rolling out and introduces App Styles! Alongside the existing Material style there is now a Cupertino style that is the default for iOS users. However, both styles are available to all under Settings > Appearance. I'm looking to take some of the new design ideas and use them to refresh the Material style in the future. Please continue to submit any issues or feature requests you might have.

title: Welcome to Tautulli Remote!
body: Important announcements will be shared though this page. Make sure to check the Help & Support section under Settings for links to support methods and device logs.
